title: Job if-expressions with a pull_request alternative: strip only the draft term, keep the pull_request branch
answers: PR CI jobs stopped running on every pull request after removing the draft check
examples, R or Windows slow tests no longer appear on non-draft PRs
how to remove a draft-PR gate from a workflow job if condition without disabling the job
body:
Symptom: after a draft-PR gate is removed, PR-triggered checks (examples, R tests, Windows slow tests, test-requirements, uc-oss, cross-version matrix) never appear on pull requests, draft or not.
Root cause: these jobs use `if: <schedule/dispatch terms> || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false)`. Deleting the whole parenthesized alternative, instead of only `&& draft == false`, makes the if false for every pull_request event. Affected spots: .github/workflows/examples.yml (jobs with the PR alternative), .github/workflows/r.yml:r, .github/workflows/slow-tests.yml:windows, .github/workflows/test-requirements.yml (skinny and core), .github/workflows/cross-version-tests.yml:set-matrix, .github/workflows/uc-oss.yml.
Fix pattern: replace the alternative with `github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, leaving the schedule `github.repository == 'mlflow/dev'` and dispatch terms unchanged.
Constraints: the workflow must still declare a pull_request trigger, or the alternative is dead. Jobs whose if was only `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || draft == false` lose the whole if, which is a different shape. Verify the event set each job accepts after editing, not just the diff text.
applies: Job-level if expressions in .github/workflows/*.yml that mention pull_request.draft.
says: Continuous integration tests stopped running on pull requests after removing draft status checks.
Automated checks like Windows tests and example suites never appear on pull requests.
Pull requests are missing verification checks and never trigger automated test runs.
Make automated test suites run on all pull requests regardless of draft status.
Pull request status checks no longer show up after changing workflow conditions.
search: When removing draft PR gating from job-level if expressions in .github/workflows/*.yml, strip only the draft check while retaining github.event_name == 'pull_request'. Deleting the entire parenthesized pull request condition completely disables PR-triggered checks across examples, R, Windows slow tests, test requirements, cross-version tests, and uc-oss. Existing repository and dispatch terms must remain untouched, and the workflow must still declare an active pull_request trigger. Jobs formatted as github.event_name != 'pull_request' || draft == false follow a different shape and lose the entire condition.
